data.title: SkillsBuild engagement CSV
data.repoDescription: Mock weekly engagement export from IBM SkillsBuild Service Center

data.title: Top 5 adult learner courses
data.prompt: Read the engagement CSV from the upstream context. Filter rows where learner_type is 'adult'. Rank by completions descending. Return the top 5 as a markdown table with columns: rank, course_id, course_title, enrollments, completions, avg_minutes_spent.

data.title: Top 5 high school learner courses
data.prompt: Read the engagement CSV from the upstream context. Filter rows where learner_type is 'highschool'. Rank by completions descending. Return the top 5 as a markdown table with columns: rank, course_id, course_title, enrollments, completions, avg_minutes_spent.

data.title: English spotlight posts (adult)
data.prompt: For each of the top 5 adult learner courses in the upstream context, draft a spotlight post in English. Each spotlight should have: a punchy headline (max 8 words), a 2-sentence description, an image alt-text suggestion, and a placeholder course link in the form https://skillsbuild.org/courses/{course_id}. Return as a markdown list with clear section breaks.

data.title: Brazilian Portuguese spotlights (adult)
data.prompt: For each of the top 5 adult learner courses in the upstream context, draft a spotlight post in Brazilian Portuguese. Same structure as English: headline (max 8 words), 2-sentence description, image alt-text suggestion, course link as https://skillsbuild.org/pt-br/courses/{course_id}. Return as a markdown list.

data.title: Localized lists (high school, 4 langs)
data.prompt: For the top 5 high school learner courses in the upstream context, produce trending lists in four languages: Arabic, Bahasa Indonesia, French, and Spanish. For each language section, include: course title (translated), placeholder link as https://skillsbuild.org/{lang}/courses/{course_id}, and a one-line suggested social format hint. Return as a markdown document with one H2 section per language.
